reviews.text: Nice courtesy of staff is awesome and excellent.

We have been going there for almost 5 years and it is hit or miss. Depending on what doctor you get you might get hassled and talked down to. They criticize you buying vaccines from the feed store (probably because they can't make more money off of you).  They talk down to you if you don't want all the shots they recommend. Pet owners can make informed choices independent from the vet in front of you and the owner should not be talked down to you because of that. The cleanliness is okay but I did worry about taking my puppy there and if they cleaned the room thoroughly. The prices are more affordable than other vets but it is not worth it anymore. We will be going elsewhere.

I brought my dog to Pets First to get a second opinion. Another vet had been charging me an astronomical amount of money for an injury that wasn't getting better. Dr. Stella immediately recognized that my dog needed specialized treatment, something my other vet had never entertained. She put in referrals and helped get to the bottom of my dog's issue. It is because of her that my dog lived another year.

I also appreciated that this place was always upfront about costs. In today's economy, that is so helpful. They helped me balance caring for my dog and getting her what she needs with what I could afford.

This past week, we had to put my sweet baby girl Athena down. When I called, the staff were so kind and understanding. The process gave me and my husband time to say goodbye and to let her go when we were ready. They were compassionate and professional.

I am so glad that we came to Pets First. I should have known from their silly signs out front (always a pet pun!) that we would be treated like family. Thank you for all of the care and love you showed Athena (and my family!) during our visits. We will be back when we are ready to open our hearts to a new dog.
Our family  will never use Pets First again. With as rude and unprofessional  as we were treated I can't  imagine how they treat the animals.

Bark bark BARK. Sniff sniff bark sniff BARK.

My dog (Johnson) wanted me to leave a review on how well Ernie takes care of him during boarding and when he is groomed. Best and most loving care during my pups stay.

Looking for a good reliable vet office that doesn’t just view your animals as just animals??? This is the place to go I’m not kidding they understood how much my puppy means to me and I needed her to go to another country with me since I’ll be living there for a while and I needed the certificate fast and they had the resources and knowledge to get it to me and I’m so incredibly greatful thank you pets first vet so much you have no clue what this means to me to be able to bring. My baby ❤️

We have been with Pets First  for almost six years. Dr Emshoff worked with us to deal with our dogs stress, anxiety and aggression associated with going into the clinic.  We had been satisfied the services up until today. We understand that our dog is a challenge. What we cannot understand is how you call yourself compassionate? Instead of helping us, you complained that he is a problem and would no longer see him. A good vet would have provided education and resources for us to get the help our dog needs.
Have been going here for my pets' care for many years. Caring vets saved my kitty's life more than once.
My dog loves his Vet. Therefore I love his Vet. The staff here is friendly and knowledgeable. They truly care about their patients.

I want to thank Dr. Stella! She has practically raised my GSD from 8 weeks old and he is now 4. I followed her to this practice and she is so worth it!!!!! GSDs, sweet and family friendly as they may be, come with so many chronic issues. There isn't a single time where I didn't feel heard or my boy's need wasn't addressed with her. Trust me when i tell you, I panic when it comes to him and I need things done right there and then. She has never let me down! Everytime, Dr. Stella and her staff have worked around my crazy schedule to get his needs addressed. She is simply amazing and we're both soooo thankful to have her in our lives! I'm sure you hear this a lot Dr. Stella, buuut thank you soo much!! :)

Saiyan and Brouk

Friendly staff, knowledgeable doctors. I have been coming here for years with my first dog, and when we got our second I knew I would be bringing him here as well. Every time I call with a concern, we are always able to be treated promptly. I moved far from there clinic but the drive is always worth it.
Have taken our last 6 dogs for health care and baths, for over 10 years. Friendly staff and willing to answer any questions.
Always great care!
Well, once again, I am truly satisfied with the care and expertise I received at Pets First. I just love everyone!!! They are just amazing!

We've been bringing our first born here for a few years now. The staff is very friendly and listen to all of our concerns, offering solutions that work for our family. They've even worked with us when needing to submit documents for insurance claims. Highly recommend checking them out if you're looking for a veterinarian in this area.

Shae here had a corneal ulcer in her eye. That took several weeks to heal. The vets here took great care of her. I loved that they communicated treatment options and felt like I was able to get my dog the best care and was still very affordable. Will always come back here.

I've been taking my bichon frise for at least 8 years to Pets First for annual check ups and vaccinations, etc., but when you really have a desperate situation with your dog is very ill, then you know whether or not the vet really cares.  I took my dog in as he was very ill on 1/22/25 and he was seen by Dr. Stella who suggested blood work and a scan and she stated that I needed to approve the estimate.  I approved an estimate and paid $956.50 for a scan and blood work.  The scan was taken on 1/23/25 but Dr. Stella never called me to tell me what the scan indicated.  I did ask for a copy of the scan and I was given a copy of the scan on 1/25/25 but Dr. Stella never had the courtesy to explain to me that Pets First would NOT do anything about my dog's issues but that they would have another oncologist vet review the results.

It appears that Pets First is not capable nor willing to have any empathy for the pet owners anguish.  I finally got a call from the "oncologist" that they had referred the test results to and it was recommended to me that I take my dog to Blue Pearl Hospital which is where he is at right now but not as a result of any rush , explanation, or caring from Pets First.

I learned my lesson and will not be taking my other bichon there any more.

Dr. Porter is not only an amazing vet, but she is a truly compassionate and caring person. We are so thankful that we met her through acupuncture for our 20-year-old cat, Baloo. She gave him mobility and better quality of life for the last 4 months of his life. We visited her at Pets First for a sick visit and then lastly for his euthanasia when he could no longer eat, drink or walk. The whole staff made the experience as peaceful as it could be. We are grateful Dr. Porter was there with us while Baloo took his last heartbeat. She spent almost an hour with us through the whole process. We also received a sympathy card from the clinic staff which was very thoughtful. Thank you.
I know most dogs dread a trip to the vet but my puppy absolutely loves going. He gets excited for grooms and visits. The staff is amazing, welcoming and friendly! I absolutely love it here!
Thank you all for taking such great care of my pup!

This office has always been impressive ♡ I just took my baby in for a dental (I work in human dentistry) and even  knowing as much as I do about dentistry I was nervous leading up to the  appointment. The girls at the front desk reassured this anxious mama & kept me posted every step of the way. But I have to say my absolute happiest moment of the day was the love & care Dr Gonzales put into my baby's visit. She showed me all the x-rays and images she took and we really geeked out about the anomaly in my pup's mouth and how much better she's going to start feeling now that it'sgone. This office has my confidence, my respect & my unwavering gratitude. Thanks Dr G & Pet's First Team ♡♡♡
They wanted 600 for an ultrasound I never heard of a price like that in my life instead of helping people,, they are out  robbing the community of there hard earned money
Thank you so much!
One star because I had a good visit ONCE but this second and last time was horrific. …
TY!

I have a very energetic German Shepherd rescued during the pandemic who is quite uncooperative when it comes to exams (not aggressive, just strongly protests by wriggling free). Dr. Emshoff is super patient with her and has accurately …

My chihuahua was sick throughout the night (nausea, stomach issues, mild dehydration) and was desperately trying to find a vet that was open (this was around 7am). After leaving all the information and medical notes with the lovely …
Such compassionate and friendly staff! I was blown away. They took our concerns seriously and were amazing with all of the pets in the lobby, including ours.
Jennifer Hernandez is the reason we continue to keep our pets here and the clinic staff is awesome. They take care of our babies. Thank you so much!
